task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. The final portfolio must contain at least five well-supported stories in every category. Treat social attention as a discovery signal rather than verification. More than half of the final stories must originate with independent, local or social discovery, using the first source in each story as the discovery source; established outlets may account for no more than half.

items.title: GEM Veeramani POCSO case: உண்மையை புதைக்க முயன்ற Chennai police! | CM Vijay | Shabbir Ahmed
items.summary: The Chennai police have identified the minor girl allegedly sexually assaulted by Gem Granites and Gem group of companies founder R Veeramani. Chennai police received a video of the assault in October 2025, but arrested Veeramani only ten months later in August 2026. The survivor’s statement has now been recorded before a Judicial Magistrate, marking a major breakthrough in the POCSO case that the Chennai police had earlier attempted to close. In this ground report, TNM's Shabbir Ahmed traces down the bungalow, where the alleged sexual assault took place and examines the questions surrounding the police's earlier attempt to close it.
